title: fix(cloud-connection): stage the ledger adoption copy without mkdtempSync, so main's dispatch-gates lane is green again

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9MmNtLnaKdSpq9S7Ah47uy)_

Fixes #30467

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 本地安装账本首次从工作目录复制到 `OS_HOME` 时用的暂存目录，改用「随机名 + 独占 mkdirSync」创建，不再用 `mkdtempSync`。行为不变：仍是账本目录旁的唯一兄弟目录，复制完重命名到位，失败即删除。
- **为什么改：** PR #30351（#30217）落地后 `main` 的 `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` 一直红：dispatch-gates 自测要求每个 `mkdtempSync` 的基路径都能从源码读出，而这里的基路径是运行时才解析的账本位置。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改一处暂存目录的创建方式，另加一行 `node:crypto` 导入；名字碰撞时非递归 `mkdirSync` 抛 EEXIST，与 `mkdtempSync` 同样不复用已有目录。回滚即撤 PR（main 会再次变红）。
- **先看：** `packages/cloud-connection/src/local-manifest-source.ts` 的 `adoptLegacyEntries`（第 333 行起那段）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/local-manifest-source.test.ts`，预期 adoptLegacyEntries 四个用例全过（含「失败不留账本目录」「不留暂存目录」）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`LocalManifestSource.adoptLegacyEntries()` (added by #30351, the breaking commit `bc254be33e`) staged its copy with `mkdtempSync(join(dirname(this.dir), ...))`. `this.dir` is the ledger location resolved at run time (`OS_HOME`, or an explicit `storageDir`), so the in-tree scratch scan in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` cannot read that base. The scan holds `mkdtempSync` to completeness (an unresolved base is a failure), so the dispatch-gates self-test case "no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read" has been red on every `main` run since.

The staging directory is now spelled as an exclusive, non-recursive `mkdirSync` of a randomly named sibling: `.LEDGER_BASENAME.adopting-HEX12` (12 hex characters from `randomBytes(6)`) under `dirname(this.dir)`. Why this spelling and not one the scan resolves: no spelling of this base can be resolved from source, because the base really is a run-time value (it may even land inside a project checkout when `OS_HOME` points there). `mkdirSync` is the shape the scan deliberately does not hold to completeness (see the "In-tree scratch directories" block of `dispatch-gates.mjs`: runtime bases are named in the report and not failed). The uniqueness guarantee is kept: a non-recursive `mkdirSync` creates the directory atomically and throws `EEXIST` rather than reuse one that is already there, as `mkdtempSync` does. The rest is byte-for-byte unchanged: the files are copied into the staging directory, it is renamed into place, and it is removed if the copy fails.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and its self-test are not touched.

## Tests

No test changes. The four existing `adoptLegacyEntries` cases in `packages/cloud-connection/src/local-manifest-source.test.ts` already pin the behaviour this keeps: every file copied, no staging directory left beside the ledger, nothing adopted once the ledger exists, and a failed copy leaving neither a ledger nor a staging directory.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation: not run. The diff changes how a directory is created, not a tested behaviour; the existing cases above are the behaviour pins and pass unchanged.
